validation.lintWarningScope: Existing mixed component/non-component exports in app-state, now included in changed-file lint.

checks: Explicit signed-in ownership confirmation and whole-profile one-account claim; foreign account sees no old source values/counts.
Highest-present legacy source priority, category validation, unsupported/corrupt/oversized source and malformed owned destination refusal. Original bytes remain intact.
Notes stable-ID merge/current wins. Missing old notes explicitly added; completed receipt prevents repeated import after later deletion.
Language-labeled vocabulary preserves labels; unlabeled list requires explicit choice. Current translation/mastery and empty revision reset win; additions bump per-language revision.
Practice counters use maximum, never addition. No streaks, entitlements, assignments, proficiency declarations, exam results or navigation/settings imported.
Only bare known module archives recover; current records/resets win, enrollment-linked records excluded. Existing subsequent explicit Core30 pair claim remains required.
Persist owned snapshot before applying UI state; quota/late identity/final receipt failure retain same-owner retry and originals. Actual reducer zero storage IO/input unchanged/deterministic.

UI requires category/ownership/language and restored current-profile readiness; failure visible; exam pages without AppProvider open learning app in separate tab. Clear browser-save/normal cloud-sync disclosure, no reload race.
Review caught bare companion-host root redirecting to Exams; corrected new-tab link to /?tab=reader. Controlled component test executes actual examsHostEntry and confirms no redirect.
limits: Controlled real-engine/reducer/component-hook tests, not a populated normal-UI browser import or current account-switch/physical-device acceptance.
No real hosted profile recovery/account writes this turn; automatic profile cloud sync is existing behavior and has no confirmed-backup guarantee here.
No cross-tab simultaneous claim/merge atomicity proof; localStorage persistence consists of guarded separate writes.
Unknown historical note deletions lack tombstones: explicit import adds missing old notes. Completed-category receipts prevent repeating the import.
Human/content/calibration/reviewer/pilot/retention/scheduler/module parity gates remain open; no schema/role/policy/speech/schedule/production changes.
Old practice activity resets without tombstones cannot be inferred; explicit activity recovery uses max as disclosed.
